subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should the four-PR lineage stack become CodexBar's long-term authoritative accounting architecture, or remain shadow-only while the narrower fork identity and cache repair is evaluated?
rationale: This PR creates a parallel accounting authority and an opaque promotion contract; repository intent is needed to choose the permanent architecture and landing order even though no concrete code defect remains.

options.title: Shadow-first rollout
options.body: Review and land the dependencies in order, keep legacy authoritative, gather exact-head corpus evidence, and defer promotion approval.

options.title: Approve lineage authority
options.body: Adopt the new architecture after the complete stack and exact-head upgrade and rollback proof satisfy the promotion gate.

options.title: Prefer the narrow repair
options.body: Pause the broad stack if https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 resolves the current user problem with materially lower maintenance risk.

recommendation.title: Shadow-first rollout
recommendation.body: Review and land the dependencies in order, keep legacy authoritative, gather exact-head corpus evidence, and defer promotion approval.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner merged and refined the current accounting behavior and performed the latest accepted runtime-proof pass in this scanner area.
